## Legs: run vs queued

### The engineering legs — RAN (offline, no ADC, no network)

- **`ops/cadence.toml`** — `[[retired_jobs]]` declares the closed
  six-name deletion contract (`aspi-egress-probe`,
  `ccops-sf-egress-probe`, `muckrock-egress-probe`,
  `okc-doc-egress-probe`, `sig-ingest-resume-test`, `sig-sink-bench`),
  each with a required reason; `sig-sink-bench`'s reason records that
  it wrote 24,811 real claims into the canonical spine. Cron
  OR-semantics corrections: `eyes_on_flock` `0 5 23 * 0` → `0 5 * * 0`,
  `openstates` `0 5 2 * 2` → `0 5 * * 2`, `congress_gov` `0 5 3 * 2` →
  `0 5 3 * *`; `sam_gov` was already clean in-repo (`0 5 * * 1`) — its
  drift is live-side, reconciled by the sweep's cron leg. Obsolete
  `cron_or_semantics_ok` flags dropped.
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py` + `ops/src/ops/live_diff.py`** —
  `RetiredJob` dataclass + `retired_lint` (unique names, required
  reasons, never colliding with cadence-owned, `[[manual_jobs]]`,
  probe, or live-diff jobs); a live job declared retired reports a
  distinct *"declared retired but still live"* finding, split from
  ordinary unlisted drift — an unlisted live job is never promoted to
  a deletion candidate.
- **`ops/src/ops/ar_cleanup.py` + `ops/gcp/ar-cleanup-policy.json` +
  `sig-ops ar-cleanup merged-policy|candidates`** — deterministic
  offline evaluator: delete versions >30d; keep <30d, newest-10 per
  package, and the merged `keep-live-referenced` rule covering every
  `@sha256:` digest a live job/service/revision references. Offline
  evaluation against the captured live image set: 95 versions → 10
  candidates / 85 kept, with 2 explicitly protected by live references
  (`ar-candidates-precheck.json`, `ar-merged-policy-precheck.json`).
- **`ops/src/ops/alerts.py` + `sig-ops alert-serve`** — the
  repo-owned alert receiver: bearer or `X-SIG-Alert-Token` credential,
  scrubbed `SIG-ALERT-RECEIVED` log lines (no body/token echo).
- **`ops/gcp/fleet-sweep.sh` (new, 923 lines)** — the gated
  leg-runner. `--check` plans the contract order offline (no ADC, no
  network, exit 0); `--apply` gates project → weekday 14:00–20:00Z
  window (else exit 42 queued) → ADC → `SIG_SWEEP_AUTHOR` → per-leg
  evidence preconditions. Leg order:
  `prestate` (sha256-sidecarred captures) → `backup` (AR-2 on-demand
  backup polled to `SUCCESSFUL`; destructive legs refuse without
  `backup/verified.txt`) → `cron` (pre-state capture, update only when
  live shows the offending schedule, post-state read-back asserted
  equal to the declared cron) → `export-guard` → `ar-dryrun` (merged
  policy + recorded candidates; **refuses if any candidate is
  live-referenced**) → `delete` (exactly the six declared names,
  describe-json+yaml recreation recipes first, absent read-back —
  never a glob) → `ar-apply` (`--no-dry-run`, post-describe asserts
  policies live + dryRun=false) → `alerts`
  (`SIG_SWEEP_ALERTS_DISPOSITION=retire|rebuild`; retire refuses if
  Monitoring coverage captures empty; rebuild pins the image digest,
  deploys the repo-owned receiver, removes `allUsers`, binds the probe
  SA) → `proof` (retired-absent + corrected-cron asserts + captured
  alert state + recorded partial live-diff). `rollback` replays
  recorded cron pre-states and prints recreation recipes; never
  window-gated.
- **`ops/gcp/export.sh` + `ops/gcp/config.sh`** — `SIG_EXPORT_GUARD`:
  the baked default command emits a refusal and exits 64, so an
  accidental `gcloud run jobs execute sig-export` cannot run stale
  deploy-time `--as-of` arguments; `export.sh run` supplies real
  arguments at execution time.
- **`ops/gcp/wave-a.sh`** — the recorded gate-rc defect fixed (the
  `if ! _gate …; then rc=$?` shape always captured 0; mirrors
  wave-b.sh's propagation pattern).
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — alert-receiver invoker identity
  declaration.
- **Tests** — `tests/ops/test_fleet_sweep.py` (19: script contract +
  fake-`gcloud` stubbed legs — window exit-42, name-checked deletes,
  backup gate, cron read-back assert, AR live-reference refusal,
  rollback replay), `test_ar_cleanup.py`, `test_alerts.py`,
  `test_live_diff.py` (retired-finding split), `test_gcp_iac.py`
  (script registered in the `--check` sweeps), `test_wave_a.py`
  (rc propagation).

- **Partial, not zero, drift** — the post-sweep live-diff can only be
  asserted partial until P35.1c lands the consolidation; declared
  drift (the `batch-05` pin, `[[manual_jobs]]`) is the only acceptable

- **`sig-sink-bench`** retirement is the urgent one — it wrote 24,811
  real claims into the canonical spine; deletion prevents another
  benchmark execution. Recorded in its `[[retired_jobs]]` reason.
- **No ADR** — the sweep executes the operator's recorded GATE-G4
  OM-20 listing and B-13 answers; it owns no new design decision (the
  receiver shape is the ticket's own interface contract).
- The live window math uses `date -u` weekday + hour only — AR-3's
  "weekday 14:00–20:00Z, excl. weekends" is the enforced subset; the
  script errs closed (any clock/eval ambiguity → exit 42).
